shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; else printf '%s\\n' 'NO_ROUND_BRIEF'; fi
sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml
rg -n \"onError|reject|non-Error|recorded|flaw|HALEngine#95\" specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "wc -l ../round-brief.md
sed -n '1,520p' ../round-brief.md
printf '%s\\n' '--- STATUS ---'
git status --short --branch
git log -3 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n -C 4 \"called with session and error when stream fails|error still propagates after onError hook|error path calls onError then afterSession|wraps an undefined rejection|works without any hooks configured|stops asking for tools once|maxToolRounds|appends an upserted|asks for suppression|counts every reporting|validation-rejection\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '120,172p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
sed -n '1,90p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
sed -n '1,100p' CHANGELOG.md
rg -n \"spec-names|changelog\" .github package.json scripts .lore 2>/dev/null"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git show --stat --oneline HEAD
git show --format= -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md HEAD
sed -n '250,415p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
rg -n \"lore-query-trace|lore_get_ci\" . || true
rg --files | rg 'spec-links|spec-names|reanchor|test-commands'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n --glob 'spec.md' \"maxToolRounds|upsert|suppression|usage|validation|no hooks|processes a message|tool result|tool rounds\" specs
rg -n --glob 'spec.md' \"works without any hooks configured|stops asking for tools once maxToolRounds is spent|appends an upserted entry|asks for suppression|counts every reporting round|validation-rejection\" specs || true
rg --files specs | sort
sed -n '1,130p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "tail -80 src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '205,232p' specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md
sed -n '326,355p' specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md
rg -n -o 'chatOrchestrator\\.test\\.ts#L[0-9]+' specs | sort"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs 'src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts::passes an Error rejection to onError unchanged'"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "timeout 300 node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs 'src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts::ChatOrchestrator tool loop passes an Error rejection to onError unchanged'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md
nl -ba src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | tail -35
rg -n -o 'chatOrchestrator\\.test\\.ts#L[0-9]+' specs | sort
git diff --check
git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
git diff --check'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts && git commit -m 'test(orchestrator): preserve Error identity for onError' && git push origin HEAD"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
